name: Required sign-in fields
steps: Open the sign-in page. Submit with both fields empty. Check the required-field validation.
expected: Blank form stays on the sign-in page
actual: True

name: Unknown account rejected
steps: Enter an unknown username and a password. Submit and inspect the error and dashboard visibility.
expected: Error shown; no authenticated dashboard
actual: Verified: Error shown; no authenticated dashboard

name: Incorrect password rejected
steps: Enter admin with an incorrect password. Submit and inspect the error.
expected: Error shown for a valid account with wrong password
actual: Verified: Error shown for a valid account with wrong password

name: SQL injection input rejected
steps: Enter an SQL-injection-style username and a password. Submit and check that authentication is denied.
expected: Injected username does not authenticate
actual: Verified: Injected username does not authenticate

name: Admin username login
steps: Enter admin / 123. Submit and wait for the Admin overview.
expected: Admin overview loads with real metrics
actual: Verified: Admin overview loads with real metrics

name: Admin dashboard metrics
steps: Inspect the five overview cards. Read dashboard data through the authenticated browser request and compare loaded metrics.
expected: Five cards loaded with database totals including product sales
actual: Five real metric cards and weekly attendance chart loaded.

name: Admin mobile-number login
steps: Sign in with mobile 0770000001 and password 123. Confirm the Admin workspace.
expected: Mobile number and password authenticate admin
actual: Verified: Mobile number and password authenticate admin

name: Member search
steps: Open Members. Search for an existing member name. Inspect the matching rows.
expected: Matching member rows remain visible
actual: Matching name: Diya Banerjee

name: Search empty state
steps: Search Members for a unique nonexistent string. Inspect the empty-state message.
expected: Unknown search shows No matching records
actual: Empty state shown for unmatched search.

name: Member table pagination
steps: Open Members with 10 rows per page. Select Next and inspect the page indicator and displayed range.
expected: Next page changes visible rows and page indicator
actual: 11–20 of 25 records

name: Member required-field validation
steps: Open Add member. Submit without required values. Confirm that the dialog stays open.
expected: Incomplete member form cannot be submitted
actual: Verified: Incomplete member form cannot be submitted

name: Mobile number validation
steps: Enter a three-digit mobile in Add member. Inspect the input pattern validation.
expected: Three-digit mobile is rejected by the form
actual: Verified: Three-digit mobile is rejected by the form

name: Initial BMI preview
steps: Enter height 175 cm and weight 72 kg. Read the calculated BMI preview.
expected: 175 cm and 72 kg calculate BMI 23.51
actual: BMI preview: 23.51

name: Create member with measurements
steps: Create an isolated member with a unique mobile, Monthly plan, paid flag, health notes, height 175 cm, weight 72 kg, and body fat 18%.
expected: Member and initial progress are saved together
actual: Created member #148

name: Member initial progress persistence
steps: Read Progress tracking for the created member. Verify one initial entry and BMI 23.51.
expected: Initial measurement is available in Progress tracking
actual: Initial measurement found with BMI 23.51.

name: Duplicate member mobile blocked
steps: Try to create another member with the same mobile and complete measurements. Inspect the duplicate error and count matching members.
expected: Duplicate mobile rejected without duplicate records
actual: Verified: Duplicate mobile rejected without duplicate records

name: Edit member and retain changes
steps: Edit the fixture member name and payment flag to Due. Save, refresh the browser, and search for the fixture.
expected: Updated name/payment flag survive a browser refresh
actual: Verified: Updated name/payment flag survive a browser refresh

name: Deactivate member
steps: Deactivate the fixture member. Confirm the new status and absence from active check-in choices.
expected: Inactive member excluded from check-in choices
actual: Verified: Inactive member excluded from check-in choices

name: Reactivate member
steps: Reactivate the fixture member. Confirm Active status.
expected: Member status returns to Active
actual: Verified: Member status returns to Active

name: Record attendance with payment warning
steps: Select the fixture member in Record check-in. Save and inspect the payment-due warning and attendance history.
expected: One check-in saved and payment-due warning shown
actual: Verified: One check-in saved and payment-due warning shown

name: Duplicate attendance blocked
steps: Attempt a second check-in for the same member on the same date. Inspect the validation error.
expected: Second check-in on same day is rejected
actual: Verified: Second check-in on same day is rejected

name: Unknown member attendance rejected
steps: Submit an attendance action with a nonexistent member ID through the authenticated browser. Inspect HTTP 400.
expected: Tampered member ID produces HTTP 400
actual: Choose an active member.

name: Create trainer and login account
steps: Create a unique trainer with valid profile details, hire date, username, and temporary password. Inspect the trainer and linked account.
expected: Profile and Trainer account created atomically
actual: Trainer and linked login created.

name: Trainer username validation
steps: Enter a trainer username starting with a digit. Inspect the username pattern validation.
expected: Username beginning with a digit is invalid
actual: Verified: Username beginning with a digit is invalid

name: Create linked Member account
steps: Create a Member account and link it to the fixture member. Confirm the account appears in User management.
expected: Account links to the selected member profile
actual: Verified: Account links to the selected member profile

name: Duplicate profile link rejected
steps: Attempt to link another account to the same member profile. Inspect HTTP 409 and the duplicate-link error.
expected: Second account linked to same member gets HTTP 409
actual: That username, mobile number, profile link, or serial number is already in use.

name: Inactive account cannot log in
steps: Deactivate the fixture Member account. Try to sign in with it and verify the inactive-account error.
expected: Deactivated Member login is rejected
actual: Verified: Deactivated Member login is rejected

name: Account reactivation
steps: Reactivate the fixture Member account in User management. Read the updated Active status.
expected: Member account is Active after reactivation
actual: Verified: Member account is Active after reactivation

name: Current admin protected
steps: Submit a request to deactivate the current Admin account. Inspect the self-protection error.
expected: Admin cannot disable own account (HTTP 400)
actual: You cannot disable your own account.

name: Create equipment
steps: Create equipment with a unique serial, purchase date, and warranty date. Read the new inventory row.
expected: Equipment profile appears in inventory
actual: Verified: Equipment profile appears in inventory

name: Edit equipment condition
steps: Edit the fixture equipment condition to UNDER MAINTENANCE. Save and reread its condition.
expected: Condition is persisted as UNDER MAINTENANCE
actual: Verified: Condition is persisted as UNDER MAINTENANCE

name: Delete unreferenced equipment
steps: Delete the unreferenced fixture equipment and confirm it no longer appears.
expected: Created equipment is removed
actual: Verified: Created equipment is removed

name: Create product
steps: Create a unique product with price 499.50 and stock 12. Confirm its inventory record.
expected: Product price and stock saved
actual: Verified: Product price and stock saved

name: Negative product price validation
steps: Enter -1 as the product price. Inspect the browser's minimum-value validation.
expected: Negative price rejected by browser validation
actual: Verified: Negative price rejected by browser validation

name: Edit product price and stock
steps: Edit the fixture product to price 549.75 and stock 20. Save and inspect persisted values.
expected: Updated price and quantity persist
actual: Verified: Updated price and quantity persist

name: Referenced product deletion protected
steps: Add a test-only order reference to the fixture product. Attempt deletion and inspect the protected-history error.
expected: Product with order history cannot be deleted
actual: Verified: Product with order history cannot be deleted

name: Delete unreferenced product
steps: Remove the fixture order reference. Delete the product and confirm removal.
expected: Product removed after fixture history is cleared
actual: Verified: Product removed after fixture history is cleared

name: Negative plan price rejected
steps: Submit a negative membership-plan price through the browser request. Confirm HTTP 400 without changing the price.
expected: Server rejects negative price (HTTP 400)
actual: Enter a nonnegative amount within the supported range.

name: Workout plan details
steps: Open a workout plan with View plan. Count and read all seven day sections.
expected: All seven workout days are readable
actual: Verified: All seven workout days are readable

name: Payment history view
steps: Open Payment history and inspect the loaded records.
expected: Saved payment records loaded in browser
actual: (None, 19)

name: Product sales view
steps: Open Product sales and inspect the loaded records.
expected: Saved sale records loaded in browser
actual: (None, 20)

name: Members PDF report
steps: Open Reports. Download the Members PDF. Parse it and confirm at least one page and a nonempty file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 4136 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

name: Trainers PDF report
steps: Download the Trainers PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 2309 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

name: Attendance PDF report
steps: Download the Attendance PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 28627 bytes; 11 PDF pages.

name: Payments PDF report
steps: Download the Payments PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 3300 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

name: Sales PDF report
steps: Download the Product sales PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 4999 bytes; 2 PDF pages.

name: Equipment PDF report
steps: Download the Equipment PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
actual: 4481 bytes; 2 PDF pages.

name: Filtered CSV report export
steps: Search Members for the fixture. Select Export CSV. Read the file and verify the matching member is included.
expected: CSV download contains visible matching member
actual: Filtered member CSV contains fixture row.

name: Local database backup
steps: Open Database backup and create a snapshot. Verify the reported SQL file exists inside the checkout's backups folder.
expected: Timestamped SQL backup exists in checkout backups folder

name: Trainer sign-in
steps: Create an isolated training assignment and sign in as the fixture trainer. Wait for the Trainer overview.
expected: Trainer account opens a separate workspace
actual: Verified: Trainer account opens a separate workspace

name: Trainer navigation restriction
steps: Inspect Trainer navigation. Confirm Assigned members exists and User management does not.
expected: Admin management links are absent
actual: Trainer navigation excludes admin modules.

name: Trainer server authorization
steps: Request the admin Members endpoint from a Trainer session. Inspect HTTP 403.
expected: Direct members API denied with HTTP 403
actual: Administrator access required.

name: Trainer assigned-member list
steps: Open Assigned members. Confirm the fixture member name and ID appear.
expected: Trainer sees their assigned member
actual: Assigned fixture member and ID displayed.

name: Trainer progress entry
steps: Record progress for the assigned member: height 175 cm, weight 71 kg, body fat 17%, current date. Inspect BMI 23.18.
expected: Assigned member progress saved with calculated BMI 23.18
actual: Verified: Assigned member progress saved with calculated BMI 23.18

name: Future progress date rejected
steps: Submit a future-dated measurement through the browser request. Inspect HTTP 400.
expected: Server rejects a future measurement date (HTTP 400)
actual: Date cannot be in the future.

name: Unassigned member progress denied
steps: Attempt progress entry for an unrelated member ID. Inspect HTTP 403.
expected: Trainer cannot write progress for an unrelated member
actual: Member is not actively assigned to you.

name: Trainer edits own profile
steps: Open the Trainer profile. Edit the fixture trainer name. Save and inspect the profile and account display.
expected: Profile and account display name update together
actual: Verified: Profile and account display name update together

name: Wrong current password rejected
steps: Attempt a password change with an incorrect current password. Inspect the error.
expected: Password is preserved when current password is wrong
actual: Verified: Password is preserved when current password is wrong

name: Password confirmation validation
steps: Enter different new and confirmation passwords. Submit and inspect the mismatch error.
expected: Mismatched new passwords cannot be saved
actual: Verified: Mismatched new passwords cannot be saved

name: Trainer password change
steps: Change the fixture trainer password with matching confirmation. Verify that the old password fails and the new password authenticates.
expected: Old password rejected and new password works
actual: Verified: Old password rejected and new password works

name: Member sign-in
steps: Sign in with the linked fixture Member account. Wait for the Member overview.
expected: Linked Member account opens member workspace
actual: Verified: Linked Member account opens member workspace

name: Member own membership view
steps: Open My profile. Confirm the member's own name, Monthly plan, and payment status.
expected: Member sees own profile, plan, and payment status
actual: Verified: Member sees own profile, plan, and payment status

name: Member attendance scoped
steps: Open My attendance. Verify only the fixture member's one check-in is returned.
expected: Only fixture member check-in is returned
actual: Verified: Only fixture member check-in is returned

name: Member progress scoped and read-only
steps: Open My progress. Verify the initial and trainer-entered measurements; confirm no add-record action exists.
expected: Own initial/trainer entries visible; no record action
actual: Verified: Own initial/trainer entries visible; no record action

name: Member training scoped
steps: Open My training. Confirm only the fixture member's assigned trainer and training record are shown.
expected: Only own training assignment is visible
actual: Verified: Only own training assignment is visible

name: Member admin API access denied
steps: Request User management data from the Member browser session. Inspect HTTP 403.
expected: User management API denied with HTTP 403
actual: Administrator access required.

name: Member progress write denied
steps: Attempt a Trainer progress action from the Member session. Inspect HTTP 403.
expected: Member cannot submit trainer progress action
actual: Trainer access required.

name: Member edits own profile
steps: Edit the fixture member's own name. Save and inspect the updated profile.
expected: Own name updates in profile and account
actual: Verified: Own name updates in profile and account

name: Desktop layout
steps: Set a desktop browser window to 1440 pixels wide. Inspect the profile and check document horizontal overflow.
expected: Document has no horizontal overflow at 1440px
actual: Verified: Document has no horizontal overflow at 1440px

name: Mobile navigation and layout
steps: Emulate a true 390 by 844 mobile viewport. Open the navigation drawer, select Progress, wait for the transition, and inspect overflow.
expected: 390px navigation works without document overflow
actual: Verified: 390px navigation works without document overflow

name: Theme persistence
steps: Toggle dark theme, refresh the page, and confirm the theme persists. Capture the rendered screen.
expected: Dark theme remains selected after page refresh
actual: Verified: Dark theme remains selected after page refresh

name: Sign-out invalidates browser session
steps: Sign out using the confirmation dialog. Confirm the login page and HTTP 401 from the protected account endpoint.
expected: Protected API requires sign-in after logout
actual: Verified: Protected API requires sign-in after logout

name: Anonymous report access denied
steps: Request a PDF report without an authenticated session. Inspect HTTP 401.
expected: Report endpoint returns HTTP 401
actual: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

name: Server source is not publicly served
steps: Request GymWebServer.java through the browser URL. Confirm HTTP 404.
expected: Source file URL returns HTTP 404
actual: Java source URL returned 404.

name: Admin account password reset
steps: As Admin, reset the fixture Member password. Verify the old password fails and the reset password works.
expected: Reset password works; old password no longer works
actual: Verified: Reset password works; old password no longer works

name: Delete member and linked account
steps: Delete the fixture member. Verify the profile, linked login, attendance, progress, and assignment are removed and sign-in fails.
expected: Member deletion cascades fixture history and login
actual: Verified: Member deletion cascades fixture history and login

name: Delete unreferenced trainer
steps: Delete the now-unreferenced fixture trainer. Confirm profile and linked account removal.
expected: Trainer and linked account removed after assignment cleanup
actual: Verified: Trainer and linked account removed after assignment cleanup

name: Module summary values
steps: Compare the Members summary card count with the current authenticated Members response.
expected: Member summary count equals loaded database rows
actual: Module summary matches the actual member record count.

name: Membership plan price update
steps: Create a test-only membership plan. Edit its price from 17.50 to 29.75 in the UI, reread the value, then remove that exact fixture plan.
expected: A valid price change is persisted for an isolated plan
actual: Fixture plan price changed from 17.50 to 29.75.
